map.电源效率LDO/DCDC 使用指南: Power Supply Efficiency LDO/DCDC User Guide
map.选择 LDO 或 DCDC 电源类型，输入输入与输出电压及电流，分别计算转换效率: Choose LDO or DCDC, enter the input and output voltages and currents, and compute conversion efficiency and power loss to assist topology selection and thermal design.
map.高压差 LDO：Vin=24V Vout=5V 100mA 效率仅 21%，必须: High-drop LDO: Vin=24V, Vout=5V, 100mA gives only 21% efficiency — DCDC is mandatory.
map.：效率 92%，输出 5W 损耗 0.43W；需 0.5W 散热（小型贴片 LD: : efficiency 92%, output 5W, loss 0.43W; 0.5W of dissipation is needed (a small SMD LDO suffices).
map.压差小/小电流/低噪声 → LDO；压差大/大电流/效率敏感 → DCDC。本工: Small voltage drop / small current / low noise → LDO; large voltage drop / large current / efficiency sensitive → DCDC. This tool provides basic electronics calculations; results are for circuit design and teaching reference only, and do not replace formal PCB design, EMC and product reliability requirements.
map.DCDC 有开关纹波（数十 mV），需 LC 滤波；LDO 输出极低噪声但效率低: DCDC has switching ripple (tens of mV) and needs LC filtering; LDO has very low output noise but low efficiency. This tool provides basic electronics calculations; results are for circuit design and teaching reference only, and do not replace formal PCB design, EMC and product reliability requirements.
map.Buck 仅降压；Buck-Boost（SEPIC）支持 Vin 可高可低于 V: Buck only steps down; Buck-Boost (SEPIC) tolerates Vin above or below Vout; the topology is more complex. This tool provides basic electronics calculations; results are for circuit design and teaching reference only, and do not replace formal PCB design, EMC and product reliability requirements.
